# awscc_kinesis_queue (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Kinesis::Queue



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `queue_arn` (String) The ARN of the queue.
- `queue_attributes` (Attributes) Mutable attributes that control queue consumption behavior. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queue_attributes))
- `queue_creation_timestamp` (String) Timestamp of when the queue was created.
- `queue_name` (String) The name of the queue. The name's uniqueness is scoped per AWS account and region.
- `queue_status` (String) The status of the queue.
- `stream_configuration_list` (Attributes List) List of stream configurations associated with the queue. v1 supports a single element; the list shape allows future extensibility to fan in from multiple streams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stream_configuration_list))
- `tags` (Attributes List) An arbitrary set of tags (key-value pairs) to associate with the Kinesis queue. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--queue_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queue_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `dead_letter_configuration` (Attributes) The dead-letter configuration applied to records that exceed the maximum receive count. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queue_attributes--dead_letter_configuration))
- `visibility_timeout_seconds` (Number) The duration, in seconds, that a received record is hidden from subsequent receive calls after being handed out to a consumer. Defaults to 30 seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--queue_attributes--dead_letter_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queue_attributes.dead_letter_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `max_receive_count` (Number) The maximum number of times a record can be received before it is moved to the dead-letter target. Required when TargetType is BUILT_IN.
- `target_type` (String) The dead-letter target type. BUILT_IN uses a service-managed dead-letter target; NONE disables dead-lettering.



<a id="nestedatt--stream_configuration_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stream_configuration_list`

Read-Only:

- `starting_position` (Attributes) The position in the stream from which the queue starts reading records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stream_configuration_list--starting_position))
- `stream_arn` (String) The Amazon resource name (ARN) of the Kinesis data stream that the queue reads from.

<a id="nestedatt--stream_configuration_list--starting_position"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stream_configuration_list.starting_position`

Read-Only:

- `timestamp` (String) The timestamp to start reading from. Required when Type is AT_TIMESTAMP; the timestamp must not be in the future.
- `type` (String) The starting position type.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 255 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.
